name: Alexander Sandor Cline MD
education: University of Budapest, Medicine (1919) — now Eötvös Loránd University
biography: Alexander "Sandor" Cline was born June 3, 1893 in Ács, Hungary, and earned his medical degree from the University of Budapest in 1919. He lived in Budapest's Lipótváros neighborhood before emigrating in 1923, sailing from Hamburg to Ellis Island to join his brother-in-law Arpad Kallos in New York, then settling in Buffalo, NY, where he practiced medicine. He was the father of Steven and Paul Cline, and died in Boca Raton, FL in May 1973.
